cases.name: Shirley Ann Soosay
cases.about:
She was a member of the Samson Cree Nation in Alberta, Canada, and is believed to be one of the first Indigenous unidentified decedents identified through forensic genealogy.

She was originally unidentified and called Kern County Jane Doe.
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; CONVICTION; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 7/14/1980, her body was discovered, stabbed 29 times, in an orchard near Delano, CA.
